text: Dream screen is solid black for 15+ s after Wake up (only Skip button + menu icon visible); state tick stays 0, no subtitles or visuals.
After ~45 s on DREAM (supposed to be ~30 s) the screen is still pure black, tick 0, no subtitles; clicking does nothing. Dream never plays or ends on its own; only Skip gets out.

Performance: game runs ~5-10 ticks/s (fps 10, host load avg ~93). Holding Left for 6 s turned the view only ~10 degrees (help says ~103 deg/s); a 0.6 s tap did nothing. Walking/turning is close to unplayable at this rate.
Good: stepping out of quarters, Ines (orange suit) is clearly visible through a window into the capsule bay across the corridor; bay door labelled SEALED CREW ONLY and floor arrows read BAY / BRIDGE.

Good: bay intercom shows CAPSULE BAY status screen 'PRE-FLIGHT - INES OKAFOR', capsule C-1 on the cradle; subtitle tags speaker 'INES - CAPSULE BAY'. Polish: the 'E Talk to Ines' prompt sits on top of the status screen text, hiding part of it.

On arriving at the bridge, a WREN subtitle 'The bridge is forward, Doctor. Out of your door, turn right, and follow the corridor.' appears on screen together with Ines's bridge line - directions to the bridge shown after I am already on it (likely a nag timer that fired late because the game ran slowly). WREN's box also has no backing panel, so it floats over the console.

Game stopped advancing at the probe console: tick stuck at 3359, state.json not updated for ~170 s, inputs (look, W) do nothing. Host load average 100-140 at the time, so likely starvation rather than a game hang.
